card.name: Punctuation after Bible book citations
card.fires_on: Colons, spaces and digits right after a Bible book name and chapter (e.g. Job 5:10) in religious nature passages. It also fires weakly on a bracket or colon after a label in lists on nature or space pages.

modes.label: Scripture verse citations
modes.description: The colon or number inside a Bible reference, especially Job, about rain, dew or creation.

modes.label: Label punctuation in nature or space lists
modes.description: A colon or opening bracket after a heading in plant or planet fact lists.
